# A synthetic console dump of the case main.c itself names: the version word
# names neither stepping (0x53 C or 0x54 D), so no channel offsets are safe
# to decode and no list is measured. The version here is 0x55, a stepping
# hvs6_dlist.h does not name. The table is otherwise probe_u3_d.txt's.
